description: Search the Reddit ads library: promoted posts advertisers run on Reddit, with advertiser, title, landing page, call to action, media, every subreddit each ad appeared in, first and last seen dates and sightings. Reddit's own house ads are excluded. Newest first; page with cursor. Billed at the read rate, the same as a post search.

advertiser.description: Advertiser username. A u/ prefix is stripped.

campaign_id.description: Reddit campaign id, as returned in an ad's `campaign_id`.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor: the previous response's `after` value, passed back exactly. A null `after` (has_more false) means there is no next page. Absent on the opening page.

limit.description: Number of ads to return, 1 to 100 (default 25).

q.description: Text to find in the ad title or the advertiser name, up to 200 characters.

since.description: ISO 8601 date: only ads last seen on or after it.

subreddit.description: Subreddit the ad was seen in. An r/ prefix is stripped.

until.description: ISO 8601 date: only ads first seen on or before it.

name: reddit_ads_search
title: Search Reddit Ads
